tests.name: jev admin stats still auth-gated (gate rows surface here)

tests.reason: The gates run inside self-healing triage, which only a real failure reaches; staging probes are read-only and cannot cause one. The gate behaviour (classification on production strings, shadow/enforce/off, dedupe window, agreement write-back, the deploy pins) is proven by these suites; on staging the shadow rows appear in jev_shadow_decisions / GET /api/v1/jev/admin/stats once a triage runs.
